note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only dictionary-based model settings for Fast-SCNN. It defines no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is used as a base config imported by other training configs via MMSegmentation's config system.
summarize_fast_scnn_config: summarize the Fast-SCNN model config with EncoderDecoder backbone and DepthwiseSeparableFCNHead decode head
review_fast_scnn_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization config with momentum 0.01 used across Fast-SCNN model components
review_fast_scnn_backbone: review the FastSCNN backbone config with global block channels 64 96 128 and fusion output channels 128
review_fast_scnn_decode_head: review the DepthwiseSeparableFCNHead decode head config with 19 classes and cross entropy loss
review_fast_scnn_auxiliary_heads: review the two FCNHead auxiliary heads with 128 and 64 input channels for multi-scale segmentation
